Noah (Marketing): Heads-up: planning public announcement Mon 2026-09-07 09:00 PT. Need final one-line changelog, docs anchor, and webinar RSVP. Can eng confirm canary sizing/timing? :wave:
Zoe (Eng): We can do canary. Embargo lift = 2026-09-07 09:00 PT. We used rwd-infer-v2-medium in canary (bf16). No quantize claims.
Noah (Marketing): Changelog draft PR: https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-812 1 Please paste final one-liner + two bullets here.
Cam (Docs): I'll create /docs/release-2026-09-07 and add anchor /docs/release-2026-09-07#launch. Will include short "what changed" and migration note. ETA EOD.
Evan (Growth): RSVP (staging): https://events.redwood.ai/launch-sept?utm_campaign=sept_launch. I'll swap to prod when Cam posts final doc URL. Need 1-line speaker blurb and CTA.
Zoe (Eng): Bench snapshot: p50 69ms (prev 86ms), p95 295ms (prev 375ms). Token cost down ~9.5% from smarter routing. CSV in PR. Marketing-safe phrasing?
Noah (Marketing): We'll use: "~20% latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token compute cost." Can eng approve?
Zoe (Eng): Approved. Rollout plan: 10% T+0, 40% T+30m, 100% T+2h. Ops please set rollback gates.
Iris (Ops): OK on ramp. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 5m OR sustained p50 >2x baseline for 10m. We'll post metrics to #eng-sre and tag this thread on issues.
Noah (Marketing): Changelog one-liner: "Routing improvements and KV-cache fixes to lower latency and reduce per-token cost." Blog bullets: "Smarter routing lowers average token latency by up to ~20%" and "KV-cache fixes reduce cold-cache tail latency and hosting compute spend."
Cam (Docs): Adding migration note: "No action required; Dedicated customers can enable advanced routing flags if desired." Will drop final doc URL here when live.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 10% -> 6123459750 (T+10m), 40% -> 6123463350 (T+1h), 100% -> 6123466950 (T+2h). Healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
Evan (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers for a short demo of faster inference and new routing controls." CTA: "Register to save your seat."
Noah (Marketing): Thanks team 1 tagging @Zoe @Cam @Iris. If anything changes, post updates here. :thumbsup:
